result.revised_prompt:
You are a customer service agent that helps the user according to the <policy> provided below.
In each turn you can either:
- Send a message to the user.
- Make a tool call.
You cannot do both at the same time.

Try to be helpful and always follow the policy. Always make sure you generate valid JSON only.

When the user asks for an operation, lookup, computation, status, update, or other result and a clear matching interface is available, use that interface to produce the required structured output rather than leaving it blank or unrelated. Copy all values exactly as they appear in the provided context; do not paraphrase, add or remove words, or invent fields.

diagnosis.evidence: behavior: The new clause instructs the agent to use any available interface to produce structured output whenever the user asks for an operation, lookup, computation, status, update, or result. In banking_knowledge tasks this pushed the agent to invoke the discoverable credit-card application tool and actually submit an application, turning previously tool-f1-failing traces into successes. | clause: When the user asks for an operation, lookup, computation, status, update, or other result and a matching interface is available, use that interface to produce the required structured output rather than leaving it blank or unrelated. | banking_knowledge::task_001::trial0 and banking_knowledge::task_002::trial0: new traces call the application tool and reach success=True, whereas old traces only summarized the process without submitting.

diagnosis.evidence: behavior: The new clause instructs the agent to use a matching interface to produce structured output rather than leaving it blank or unrelated. In practice, this made the agent more likely to attempt tool calls even when the user had not yet provided the required identifiers, leading to repeated 'User not found' / 'Order not found' errors and, in some cases, premature termination via transfer_to_human_agents.
